claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 25-27 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:49-7:50 p.m. PT.
The Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E).
The rocket followed a southern trajectory.
Starlink 17-35 was a mission for Starlink satellites to low-Earth orbit.
The first-stage booster was on its 10th flight.
The first-stage booster attempted to land on the droneship "Of Course I Still Love You".
The launch was visible across Southern California.
A launch attempt on Sunday was scrubbed due to upper-level winds.
